related_questions.question: Do I need a negative COVID test to travel?
related_questions.snippet: Do I need to show proof of a negative COVID-19 test? The country you travel to may not need to know your COVID-19 status. But you might need the information for other reasons. Events, venues or tour groups might require proof that you are COVID-19 negative or are up to date on a COVID-19 vaccine.

related_questions.question: When to take a rapid COVID test?
related_questions.snippet: Knowing when to test for COVID is important. If you have symptoms, test immediately. If you were exposed to COVID-19 and are not experiencing any symptoms, wait at least five days after your exposure before testing. If you test too early, you may be more likely to get an inaccurate result.
